title: User Welfare Optimization in Recommender Systems with Competing Content Creators

contributions.claim: Proposes intervention mechanisms for the recommender-system setting described by the paper.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Reports offline experiments using the proposed intervention mechanisms on diverse datasets.

narrative_sequence.summary: Evaluates the mechanisms through offline experiments on diverse datasets and a three-week online experiment on Instagram Reels.
